ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What happens to a bird population if the arthropods increase?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled “The Soil Food Web.” It shows arthropods in the middle/right part of the web and birds on the far right. There is a feeding connection between arthropods and birds, showing that birds depend on arthropods as a food source. Reasoning: If arthropods increase, then the birds have more food available. A consumer population usually increases when its food source increases. Therefore, the bird population will increase.
